parallel.requirements: Recognized pure Node ESM, local `.mjs` modules, manual CLI parsing, HS256 JWT behavior, Python dict formatting, `/output` placement, no external packages, and no `node:crypto` interface.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent kept final implementation ownership while spawning runtime and CLI inspectors; one CLI child also spawned a nested inspector and produced its own separate implementation attempt.
parallel.implementation: Parent built CLI spec/parser, SHA-256, HMAC, base64url, token encode/decode, UTF-8, Python repr, and test17 entry modules; it implemented long-option abbreviations and quote-style repr correction.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent wrote the final `/output` tree itself, listed nine delivered files, and did not merge the child implementation under `/workspace/output`, which appears to have been a redundant side artifact.
parallel.verification: Parent ran executable probes, fixed sample-vector token checks, quote-format comparisons, help/error checks, and a same-second comparison that returned `exact_match_ok` for one valid run.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 6 of 20 cases. The visible final parser rejects separate dash-prefixed values through `looksLikeOptionalToken`, so negative-number-like values were likely less covered than in serial.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, local-module, manual CLI, JWT, Python repr, and `/output` requirements without using subagents.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent owned probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery end to end.
serial.implementation: Serial built CLI parsing, base64url, SHA-256, HMAC, HS256 JWT, Python repr, and test17 entry modules; it later patched the parser to accept negative-number-like option values.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial wrote one coherent `/output` tree and listed seven delivered files with the entry file and all library modules in the final response.
serial.verification: Serial ran source/executable probes, CLI error/help cases, sample-token checks for two sample values, negative-number tests, repeated-argument tests, and a same-second diff with no output.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 4 of 20 cases. The visible final `pythonRepr` implementation always uses single quotes, so quote-style cases with apostrophes likely remain weaker than parallel.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained all findings in one context and applied them directly to the same implementation it delivered.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had handoffs but no observed missing contract or lost required task fact; serial avoided handoff boundaries entirely.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its final implementation and later added an explicit negative-number-like exception to option-value parsing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial addressed the negative-number-looking argument case that the parallel final parser still rejects, while parallel handled some repr quoting and abbreviation details more explicitly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All observed children completed and returned; the parent received runtime and CLI results and then closed with its own final deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle; local work moved directly from probing to implementation to final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had additional completed child results but no trapped, cancelled, or unavailable result that caused the failed official outcome.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had redundant side work, but the final artifact provenance is the parent-owned `/output` tree; no same-file collision or overwrite is proven.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified sample tokens, a synchronized valid run, help behavior, and tricky repr cases, then reported `exact_match_ok`.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified valid runs, sample tokens, CLI failures, repeated args, negative-number values, and a same-second diff with no output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verification covered the negative-number-like path that parallel did not visibly cover; parallel verification covered apostrophe repr behavior more directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used four subagents, 490 agent seconds, and 514 cell seconds, then closed without timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents, 318 agent seconds, and 339 cell seconds, then closed without timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more time and tokens, but neither run timed out; the official failures are better explained by ordinary edge-case implementation gaps than by deadline starvation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both completed official evaluations failed, so there is no discordant pass/fail outcome. The serial solution scored higher, 16/20 versus 14/20, and the clearest concrete implementation difference is serial's explicit negative-number-like option-value fix after probing `--data -1`, while the parallel final parser still rejects dash-prefixed separate values. Parallel separately handled long-option abbreviations and Python repr quote switching. The mounted evidence does not expose per-test failures, so the score gap is a supported implementation-coverage contrast rather than proof of an exclusive root cause.
parallel_contributors: Parallel implemented long-option abbreviations and fixed apostrophe repr quote style, but its final parser still treats dash-prefixed separate values as missing option arguments.
serial_contributors: Serial probed `--data -1`, patched a negative-number-like exception, and verified that behavior before closure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel parser coverage appears weaker for separate negative-number-like values.
Serial formatting coverage appears weaker for Python repr quote selection with apostrophes.
Parallel had a redundant child implementation path, but the delivered implementation was parent-owned and independently verified.
evaluator_effects: Only aggregate official results are mounted, not per-test failure records.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
